blocks.text: Apna khayal achhi tarah pitch karna use haqeeqat banane ki zaroori himayat dilata hai; chhota karobar ho ya bara project, achhi pitch bara farq dalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Business pitch ki ahmiyat samjhaiye (short question 5).
blocks.explanation: Yeh khayal ke liye zaroori paisa, shurakaa aur gahak dilati hai: wazeh, qail karne wali pitch investors ko sarmaya aur doosron ko himayat ya khareedari par aamada karti hai.

items: Achhi pitch himayat, sarmaya aur gahak dilati hai.
